svg.title: Self-liquidating acquisition to backend ascension
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-02-demand-validation-funnel; chart type: funnel; title: Self-liquidating acquisition to backend ascension; subtitle: Illustrative cohort of 1,000 targeted visitors; chapter number: 6; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Invented nested cohort counts illustrating funnel math; actual conversion varies by traffic source and offer.; caption: Newsletter co-registration and front-end order bumps offset acquisition spend so backend community and bundle sales become high-margin profit.; stages: label: Targeted clicks; value: 1,000; numeric value: 1000.0; detail: High-intent visitors from YouTube tutorials, Reddit SERP threads, GEO citations, or paid tests.; label: Lead-magnet opt-ins; value: 380; numeric value: 380.0; detail: 38% opt-in to a free calculator or lite template with optional paid newsletter co-registration.; label: Core SKU buyers; value: 34; numeric value: 34.0; detail: 3.4% front-end conversion on a $49 operational toolkit or template system.; label: Bump & upsell buyers; value: 13; numeric value: 13.0; detail: 38% order-bump attachment and 14% 1-click post-purchase bundle upgrades.; label: Annual subscribers; value: 5; numeric value: 5.0; detail: Ascended members on a $290-$490/yr update feed or operator community.
